scope: Goal-focused, at the user's direction: ss 19(14)-(15), 20(15), 22, 24(5), (8)-(11), 54(3), 55(3), 56(3)-(4) of the revised text as at 6 April 2026. Whether goods or services conform is an input. Left out on purpose: the statutory terms, digital content, delivery and risk, hire and severable variants, partial rejection, unfair terms (Part 2), Parts 3-4.

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this against the Act. An independent test pass was run on 2026-10-18 (tests-independent.l4, 82 assertions from expectations written before the encoding was read); none failed. Its remark that a deduction larger than the price gave a negative refund led to a floor at 0. Dates are computed as the Act words them, with no working-day rule. The pipeline has not been run.

forks.F1: s 22(3): last event E; limit E + 30.
forks.F2: s 22(4): earlier of 30 days and the perishable period.
forks.F3: s 22(6)-(8): waiting period counts both days; added to the limit; a request after the limit changes nothing.
forks.F4: s 22(7): later of received + 7 and the extended limit.
forks.F5: s 19(14): six months beginning with delivery, corresponding-date rule.
forks.F6: s 24(10)-(11): first 6 months from E + 1; no deduction unless motor vehicle; refund floored at 0.
